_note: Operator-supplied 2026-09-22 (uploaded alongside a blank Illinois MFUT-15 IFTA return calculator template, which confirmed these are a DIFFERENT tax from standard IFTA fuel tax -- that template's own jurisdiction rate table prices CT diesel fuel at $0.524/gal, KY at $0.234/gal, NM at $0.21/gal and NY at $0.3875/gal, all separate line items from the per-mile rates below). These five states each run their own WEIGHT-DISTANCE or highway-use tax on heavy trucks, charged per mile on top of (Oregon: instead of) standard IFTA fuel tax: Oregon's Weight-Mile Tax, Connecticut's Highway Use Fee (since 2023), New Mexico's Weight-Distance Tax, New York's Highway Use Tax (HUT), and Kentucky's KYU (Weight Distance Tax). Rates are the operator's stated per-mile figures for an 80,000-lb combination vehicle -- actual per-truck rates are tiered by declared/registered weight, so a truck registered below 80,000 lbs would owe a lower rate than shown here; this is a fleet-wide approximation, not a truck-specific one.
OR_note: Oregon ALSO has real, filed weight-mile tax returns in this corpus (ingest/parse_oregon.py, analysis/oregon_gap.py) for ZONE and partially for XTRACK -- cost_structure.oregon_per_mile() uses those REAL figures where a filed return exists, and only falls back to this schedule rate x mile-share estimate where it does not (XTRACK's gap quarters, AFG entirely -- AFG has no Oregon account on record).
CT_note: Connecticut's Highway Use Fee is charged on vehicles with a gross weight over 26,000 lbs -- separate from, and in addition to, the CT diesel IFTA fuel tax already priced in the filed IFTA returns.
KY_note: KYU applies to vehicles over 59,999 lbs.
NM_note: New Mexico's Weight-Distance Tax rate scales by declared weight bracket; 0.059 is the operator's stated figure for the 80,000 lb bracket.
NY_note: New York's Highway Use Tax offers a truck-weight method (used here) or an unloaded-weight method; 0.055 is the operator's stated truck-weight-method figure for 80,000 lbs.
source: Operator, chat, 2026-09-22 -- official state tax schedules, not independently verified against a primary state filing in this corpus.
